question: How much did checkout conversion fall after release 26.3, and for which orders?
title: Size and shape of the fall
summary: Conversion fell from 3.1% to 2.6% between the weeks of 23 February and 9 March. The fall is in card payments (3.0% to 2.3%); PayPal stayed at 3.4%. The analytics page is the only primary source; the leadership update repeats its figures. Its challenge question is still to come.
gist: Conversion fell from 3.1% to 2.6%, all of it in card payments.
stakes: whether the fall points to one payment method or to the whole checkout
done_when: a dashboard or analysis gives conversion before and after the release, by payment method
